name: Golgari undercity
description: The Golgari realm beneath Ravnica, home of Korozda the maze and the cathedral of Svogthos.

timeline.summary: Vraska leads the Phyrexians into the Golgari undercity, transforming her people into Phyrexians while Realmbreaker upends Korozda and cracks Svogthos.
timeline.quote: It is a hive in the truest sense, all pieces of a single purpose.
